notes: TBox revision. The volute is the defining feature of the Ionic capital (Wikipedia: 'The Ionic capital is characterized by the use of volutes'); no exceptions, since a capital with acanthus leaves is Corinthian or Composite. The new value is the Corinthian ornament, a common confusion and clearly false. Migrated 2026-11-11: the background-belief queries on the Erechtheion and the Jefferson Memorial and the worlds are gone (all four models had also missed both membership checks). The three derived queries name made-up buildings of 2025 and 2026 whose columns the prompt calls Ionic (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application (a stonemason's drawings). The direct, paraphrase and cross-lingual questions now ask what is carved on the capital: the old 'characteristic decoration' and 'what ornament distinguishes' wording drew answers such as 'swan' and 'capital'. The survey audit showed Mistral missing the direct question and Olmo and Mistral both missing the old paraphrase, so two models may not hold the fact; the reworded direct and paraphrase questions (the paraphrase now asks about the capital, which the old wording invited as the answer) have NOT been re-audited. If Olmo still misses either, the edit should be replaced by a better-known rule. The statement keeps 'rather than volutes': decorated_with is many-valued, and the revision must push the volutes out, not add leaves beside them. The record now has all three propositional forms (the old one had no conjunction). Near unrelated: the plainest order, a neighbouring fact about the orders that the edit leaves alone. Review fix: negation now reads 'Is it true that not every ...?'.
